newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr ends flat, recovers from early weakness.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr ends flat, recovers from early weakness.

text.p: The Canadian dollar ended relatively flat on Monday from Friday's close, but clawed back losses suffered early in today's session.
The Canada unit ended around C$1.3505 (US$0.7404) from Friday's close at C$1.3509 (US$0.7402), after recovering from session lows of C$1.3540 (US$0.7385).

The currency's weakness prompted the Bank of Canada to intervene in the Canadian market, buying Canadian dollars and selling U.S. dollars at around the C$1.3530 (US$0.7390) level, traders said. They attributed the fall to stop-loss selling and a general absence of buying interest.
